name: setup-manaflow-ai-paper-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: a theme file for color, settings for type and spacing, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards, and a customize view for the sidebar's hover card and rows. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Paper sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Paper's hover card and sidebar rows: the task in full, medium names and an arc while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/paper.json:
// Paper: warm off-white paper, ink-brown text and a sepia accent. No wallpaper; a soft sidebar a
// shade darker than the page.
{
  "name": "Paper",
  "description": "Warm paper, ink text, a sepia accent and a soft sidebar.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#faf8f3", "foreground": "#2d2a26", "selection": "#e8e1d3", "accent": "#8a5a2b" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#f1ede4",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#faf8f3",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",

  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
